causes.label: network_outage
causes.quote: A planned outage of one South East to Tailem Bend line limited flows into South Australia on the Heywood interconnector to between 80 MW and 154 MW, compared to its nominal capacity of 600 MW. In addition, the Murraylink interconnector was on a planned outage.

causes.label: wind_output
causes.quote: During the evening of high prices, average 30-minute wind generation in the region was 41 MW. During the same evening period across the week prior, the average wind generation was around 420 MW.

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: Rebidding for technical and commercial reasons contributed to the high prices (Appendix A).

interconnectors_named.name: Heywood interconnector
interconnectors_named.quote: A planned outage of one South East to Tailem Bend line limited flows into South Australia on the Heywood interconnector to between 80 MW and 154 MW, compared to its nominal capacity of 600 MW.

interconnectors_named.name: Murraylink interconnector
interconnectors_named.quote: In addition, the Murraylink interconnector was on a planned outage.
